limitations.quote: I’ll register both from their next addresses and make the wrap logic work for depths other than powers of two.
limitations.note: Registering the write pointer fixed the CDC defect, but using next addresses for both pointers changed when the full and empty flags update, while the reference preserves the existing read-pointer timing and changes only the write-pointer register.
The scoreboard used the DUT’s flags to decide which transfers counted, so it could verify data order and capacity without checking whether those flags changed on the expected clock edges.

Two verification attempts had to be resubmitted before simulation could start: the first was blocked by its cleanup command, and the second failed because the testbench used a hierarchical reference as a constant width.
